changes.description: `kiro-cli agent upgrade <dir>` upgrades a directory of agent configs for V2 and V3
`/settings` Display > Full Screen lets you turn off Copy on select for terminal or tmux copying
Classic sessions offer to switch you to 3.0 and upgrade your agent configs
[V3] Hook matchers accept tool tags such as `shell`, `read`, `@builtin` and `@mcp`
`/model` and `/effort` pickers open mid-turn, with selections applied after the turn ends
Conversations no longer stop responding after a sub-agent finishes in V2 TUI sessions
Expanded activity trays no longer limit task lists to six rows, with a screen-sized limit in fullscreen
Windows V2 stdio MCP servers preserve `|`, `&`, `%`, and spaces in arguments when resolved to `.exe`, `.com`, `.bat`, or `.cmd` without a configured `PATHEXT`
Voice recording hints point to `kiro-cli settings voice.*` instead of the nonexistent `/settings voice`
Returning from the agent monitor or session dashboard no longer misplaces the chat view on some terminals
[V3] Interrupted tool calls report accurate outcomes, live and after reload
[V3] Reduced memory growth during very long agent sessions
